package.name: swiftcov
package.summary: Fast, Xdebug-API-compatible code coverage (line, branch, path) for PHP.
package.description: swiftcov is a PHP Zend extension that provides code coverage (line, branch and path) through the Xdebug coverage API, so PHPUnit / php-code-coverage / Cobertura tooling consume it unchanged. It analyses each op_array into basic blocks once and records one byte per executed block at runtime, reconstructing lines/branches/paths at collection time. Branch and path coverage therefore cost about the same at runtime as line coverage -- roughly an order of magnitude faster than Xdebug for path coverage. The extension registers at runtime under the module name "xdebug" for tool detection, but ships as the distinct product/package "swiftcov". Coverage only (no debugger, profiler or tracer beyond the Cachegrind profiler).
package.notes: 0.5.0: distinct publishable product/package identity. The build/package name is now "swiftcov" (composer juslintek/swiftcov, PECL swiftcov, extension swiftcov) so PECL/PIE/Packagist accept it and trademark friction with "xdebug" in the package name is avoided. The RUNTIME module name still registers as "xdebug" so php-code-coverage/PHPUnit keep detecting it. The previous fast_xdebug_* helper functions are retained as documented BC aliases; new canonical swiftcov_engine() / swiftcov_resolved_mode() / swiftcov_recommended_settings() are added. No change to coverage output. Coverage + Cachegrind profiler; step debugging still not implemented. PHP 8.2-8.5.
